title: gh pr list --head ${branch} --state ${state} --json ${field} --limit ${forge_list_limit} --jq ${filter}
description: Pull requests, newest first: the open ones' headRefName, without --head or --jq, in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:branch-for-issue), and the first one's number, headRefOid, or state on a branch, without --limit, in forge/github:on-branch (from forge/github:pr-for-branch, forge/github:pr-head-for-branch, forge/github:pr-last-for-branch, forge/github:pr-state-for-branch, and forge/github:pr-here). The types are the PullRequest object of GitHub's GraphQL schema, https://docs.github.com/public/fpt/schema.docs.graphql, as gh renders its fields (https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/api/queries_pr.go).
